abstract: Ovarian tumors are classified on the basis of tumor origin as epithelial tumors (serous and mucinous tumors, endometrioid and clear cell carcinomas, Brenner tumor), germ cell tumors (mature and immature teratomas, dysgerminoma, endodermal sinus tumor, embryonal carcinoma), sex cord-stromal tumors (fibrothecoma; granulosa cell, sclerosing stromal, and Sertoli-Leydig cell tumors), and metastatic tumors. Epithelial tumors are primarily cystic and, when malignant, are associated with varying proportions of a solid component. Papillary projections are a distinctive feature of epithelial tumors. Profuse papillary projections are highly suggestive of borderline (low-malignant-potential) or malignant tumor. Ovarian teratomas demonstrate lipid material at computed tomography and magnetic resonance (MR) imaging. Malignant germ cell tumors manifest as a large, complex abdominal mass that contains both solid and cystic components. Tumor markers are helpful in diagnosis. The radiologic appearance of sex cord-stromal tumors varies from small solid masses to large multicystic masses. Granulosa cell tumors are usually large multicystic masses with solid components. Fibrothecoma, sclerosing stromal tumor, and Sertoli-Leydig cell tumors are usually solid masses. Fibromas have very low signal intensity on T2-weighted MR images. Certain radiologic findings predominate for each type of tumor. Knowledge of these key features of ovarian tumors provides the criteria for making a specific diagnosis or substantially narrowing the differential diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 卵巣腫瘍は起源により、上皮性腫瘍（漿液性および粘液性腫瘍、類内膜癌および明細胞癌、Brenner腫瘍）、胚細胞腫瘍（成熟および未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌）、性索間質性腫瘍（線維莢膜腫、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍、硬化性間質腫瘍、Sertoli-Leydig細胞腫瘍）、転移性腫瘍に分類されます。上皮性腫瘍は主に嚢胞性で、悪性の場合は充実性成分の割合がさまざまです。乳頭状突起は上皮性腫瘍に特徴的な所見であり、多量の乳頭状突起は境界悪性（低悪性度潜在性）または悪性腫瘍を強く示唆します。卵巣奇形腫はコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴(MR)画像で脂質成分を示します。悪性胚細胞腫瘍は、充実性成分と嚢胞性成分の両方を含む大きく複雑な腹部腫瘤として見られます。腫瘍マーカーは診断に有用です。性索間質性腫瘍の画像所見は、小さな充実性腫瘤から大きな多嚢胞性腫瘤まで多様です。顆粒膜細胞腫瘍は通常、充実性成分を伴う大きな多嚢胞性腫瘤です。線維莢膜腫、硬化性間質腫瘍、Sertoli-Leydig細胞腫瘍は通常、充実性腫瘤として見られます。線維腫はT2強調MR画像で非常に低信号を示します。各腫瘍型には特定の画像所見が優位に見られ、それらの主要な特徴を理解することで、特異的な診断を下すか、鑑別診断を大幅に絞り込むことができます。
